answer: Rule: each epoch the network mints only 100 yarrow passes, drawn by verifiable lottery from the nebula of applicants. Entering the draw burns 50 POA, and every loser's burn feeds the pool that pays honest operators. One fake costs 50 POA on average; flooding the draw widens the canyon between cost and reward, because with N fakes the expected price per admission rises to 50 x (entrants/100), so the attacker's bill grows with each extra fake instead of staying flat.
